text:
oliver: quick heads-up — using the new next-eval-starter (next + eval-harness) and the JS sample's eval runner shows 0 failures locally but the Python harness reports regressions in the same prompt set. confused.

oliver: repro: clone repo, yarn && yarn test:evaluate-js -> passes. python/harness/run_eval.py against same model+prompts -> shows 4 regressions. both target the same model version.

rita: are the prompt sets identical? line endings/whitespace can change expected tokens.

oliver: diffed them, they're byte-identical. both call /v1/evals but payloads differ — JS SDK sends `response_format: "json"` and python sends `format: "structured"` because of different default param names.

samir: ah, classic SDK parity issue. JS and Python had different param names in eval.create call last release. JS maps `responseFormat` -> `response_format` but python used `format` historically. we added a compatibility shim in 0.12.1 for python but the JS sample still uses the old alias.

mira: which versions are in the starter?
oliver: package.json shows @redwood/inference-js ^0.12.0 in the template. python harness pinned to redwood-evals 0.12.1.

rita: so mismatch. two fixes: 1) normalize the SDKs to use canonical param name `response_format: "structured"` in both samples, 2) add a small conformance test that POSTs an eval payload and asserts the ingestion schema.

doc-bot: suggested doc change: add note in README "Eval harness parity: ensure response_format param uses canonical name to avoid false regressions" and link to SDK changelog.

samir: also add unit test in JS runner that loads the same prompt set file and runs the minimal eval API with a mock to assert identical request body as the python runner. catches drift early.

oliver: i'll open a PR to update the starter and add the conformance test. quick patch: replace alias keys and bump @redwood/inference-js to 0.12.2.

mira: can we also add a tiny CI job that runs both the JS and Python harnesses against the mocked eval server? would save future churn.

oliver: good idea — adding to PR. will include CHANGES and a short blurb in the onboarding doc for eval maintainers so they know to check SDK parity when adding new params.

samir: thanks — glad we caught this before it hit a customer.

oliver: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/samples/pull/2781 "next-eval-starter: eval param parity, conformance test, bump SDK". doc-bot created issue #1702.

rita: nice work. small PSA for starter authors: add cross-language conformance tests for any eval/metrics pipeline.

oliver: will follow up with a short demo in the devex office hours next week.
